usedFor: Envoy for Visitors records who is coming and Brevo holds your contacts, so “Visitor Invited” feeds “Add Or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Visitor Invited” in Envoy for Visitors, then “Add Or Update Contact” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: Each invited visitor is added to Brevo, and one who is already there is updated instead.

watchOut: “Visitor Invited” in Envoy for Visitors is polling, so contacts reach Brevo after a scheduled check.
